title: P0 v2 Gate 1 trusted control-plane evidence v2
description: Final trusted evidence. Candidate reports are untrusted inputs and never authorization.

evidence_stage.description: Stage-specific truth contract. authorization_rejected means a structurally valid canonical authorization was rejected before acquisition; malformed raw input is not represented as a valid canonical authorization. broker_failed is the closed broker/client failure envelope and includes the exact normal 22/22 complete transcript when candidate-report construction, write, or flush fails before report bytes are accepted.

staging.description: Null means no complete staging set was accepted and no candidate process was started. Any partial untrusted bytes must be removed before this record and are bound only by the error/recovery evidence; arrays contain only the complete trusted staging set.

broker.description: Null means no candidate process, broker instance, transcript, UID/GID, isolation claim, accepted request, or completed response existed.

ordered_parents.description: Trusted main SHA followed by the exact candidate head SHA.

partial_broker_count_order_normal.description: A partial normal-phase synchronous transcript can have at most one accepted request without a completed response and cannot be the terminal complete 22/22 pair.

complete_broker_without_candidate_report.description: The normal finite broker exchange completed all 22 request/response pairs, including FINISH, but candidate report construction, write, or flush failed before any candidate report bytes were accepted.

partial_broker_count_order_cancellation.description: A partial cancellation-phase synchronous transcript is bounded by four requests, can trail by at most one response, and cannot complete a response to WAIT_CANCELLATION.

pre_candidate_cancellation_state.description: No candidate or broker existed, no cancellation was requested, no finalizer ran, and the untouched host is already in the safe empty/restored state.

post_candidate_non_cancellation_state.description: A broker existed but no ordinary cancellation was requested; trusted cleanup completed before failure evidence was accepted.
